items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: The transcript identifies the interviewee as Frederick C. Miner (Fred Minor). The 'PERSON TO JUDGE' is Frederick C. Miner. The interviewee is referring to himself.

ctx.x: I want to make a note that the date is November 1st in All Saints Day in 1961 and we're over at 1109 South Galvez interviewing Mr. Fred Miner. Do you mind giving me your full name and also your nickname? How do you spell it?
Frederick C. Miner is my correct name. My nickname everybody call me H. A-C-H-I-E.
I used to say it was just like H, the letter H. That's what I thought it was, just like the letter H.
